captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a service-station floor pump, consisting of a dark blue tubular barrel, a wide foot stand with black foot pads, and a silver-grey collar at the top of the barrel. A metallic silver piston rod extends upwards from the barrel to a horizontal black T-handle. Mounted near the bottom is a circular pressure gauge with a white face, black ticks, and a red needle, topped by a small red pressure-release button. The handle and piston rod slide vertically along the pump axis, the gauge needle rotates on its central pivot, and the red button can be pressed down prismatically.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a service-station floor pump. It must feature a dark blue main cylinder, a T-handle with a metallic piston rod, two black foot pads on a blue base, a circular pressure gauge housing with a red needle, and a small red button on top of the gauge. Ensure the handle translates prismatically along the vertical axis, the gauge needle rotates continuously, and the red button has a prismatic downward motion limit.
captions.factory: Construct the pump base using a Box for the main footrest and two black Boxes for the foot pads. Model the main body with a tall Cylinder, adding a grey collar Cylinder at the top. Create the gauge assembly using a Cylinder for the housing, a thin white Cylinder for the face, and a thin red Box for the needle. Create the handle assembly as a vertical metallic Cylinder for the rod and a horizontal black Cylinder for the T-bar. Finally, define three articulations: a prismatic joint for the handle/piston rod relative to the main body, a continuous revolute joint for the gauge needle, and a prismatic joint for the red release button.
